media.title: Nader Dabit demonstrates a cloud agent running on a real Mac with Xcode and iOS Simulator

title: Give Cloud Agents a Real Mac with Xcode and iOS Simulator
summary: Nader Dabit demonstrates provisioning a clean, real Mac environment for each cloud-agent session with a selected macOS and Xcode version. The recording shows how remote agents can reach the Apple-only build and simulator surface that Linux cloud workers lack.
takeaway: Create a reproducible Mac runner image with pinned macOS and Xcode versions, then require each remote-agent task to build and run in a fresh instance before it can open a PR.
